designationHistory.name: winter game (elk) reserve
designationHistory.indexText: Congress provided for the establishment of a winter game (elk) reserve in Wyoming, south of Yellowstone, in the appropriations act approved August 10, 1912 (37 Stat. 293).
designationHistory.note: Signer is inferred from the date of approval (Taft was President in August 1912); no source here shows his signature. The 1912 provision took the form of an appropriation. Named Elk Refuge in later orders; renamed National Elk Refuge by Proclamation 2416, July 25, 1940.
